findings.fact: North is acting and holds D8, D6, D5, D3; the diamond ace belongs to South.
findings.explanation: The selected DA is not held by dummy. The plan and reason also incorrectly place the ace in dummy, making the proposed immediate play illegal.
quotes: Win the diamond lead with dummy’s ace
Dummy has only the diamond eight over West’s queen, so play the ace to secure the trick and retain control.
